page.overview:
Who is Lettie?

Lettie, also known as Lede, is one of two Ultima Demons disguised as women from Final Fantasy Tactics. Like her fellow demon, Celia, Lettie serves as assassin of the Lucavi demon Zalera.

Lettie is a one of the special elite demons who serve the Lucavi, a supernatural demonic race originating from another dimension connected to the world of Ivalice.

1200 years after Ultima's defeat and imprisonment within the body of her vessel, the other Lucavi, led by Hashmal, carried out a plot to orchestrate a war in Ivalice and thus possess people in high positions through the auracites to do their bidding so they could free their leader through a complex ritual that required an immense shedding of blood. After the conflict began and Zalera took control of Marquis Messam Elmdore of Limberry, Lettie and Celia were summoned by him as his assistants and disguised as assassin women.

Celia and Lettie assisted Elmdore on his mission to recover the Virgo auracite held by Grand Duke Gerrith Barrington, the ruler of Riovanes Castle. They only arrived after Hashmal (possessing Folmarv Tengille, the leader of the Knights Templar of Church of Glabados) and Belias (possessing Wiegraf Folles, the former leader of the Corpse Brigade who had become a Knight Templar) had begun massacring Barrington's guard in retaliation of the aristocrat's trying to force them into an alliance in exchange for the Zodiac Stone. Ramza Beoulve killed Belias, and Rapha Galthena, Barrington's former subordinate, cornered the grand duke on the castle roof. The duke fatally shot her brother, Marach, while threatening to shoot Rapha as well if she did not hand over the Scorpio auracite that was in her brother's robes. The assassin trio revealed themselves after Lettie killed Barrington by throwing him off the roof. Since Ramza had also arrived at the scene and ordered Rapha to retreat after realizing the three were demons in disguise, they attacked them to obtain their auracites. Ramza and his allies defeated the trio, forcing Elmdore into a tactical retreat.
